author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Right on the heels of the Bambu Lab H3C comes the P3C, a smaller 3D printer utilizing the same Swaptek toolhead changing system as the recently-released flagship. We share our experience multicolor printing with the P3C and examine the design decisions and compromises that allowed this printer to launch at a surprisingly aggressive price. 

Bambu Lab P3C: https://us.store.bambulab.com/products/p3c
Disclosure: This product was sent to us by the manufacturer for purposes of review and is not sponsored. 

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
